newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Sinophil says 1996 net at 49.28 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Sinophil says 1996 net at 49.28 mln pesos.

text.p: Oil explorer Sinophil Corp said on Thursday its net income was 49.289 million pesos in 1996 on total revenues of 52.407 million pesos.
Comparative figures for 1995 were not available.
Its total expenses for the period was 3.119 million pesos, according to company documents submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company had earlier said its board had approved an increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from two billion.
Recently, Sinophil shares had risen on the Philippine Stock Exchange on rumours it would diversify into property.
